import pandas as pd

# File paths for the source data
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_45/test_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_45/test_1.csv"

# Load Source 0
# Schema: ['State', 'Participation', 'English', 'Math', 'Reading', 'Science', 'Composite']
df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path)

# Load Source 1
# Schema: ['State', 'Participation', 'Evidence-Based Reading and Writing', 'Math', 'Total']
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path)

# Rename columns in df0 to match target schema partially:
# Participation -> Participation_x
# Math -> Math_x
df0_renamed = df0.rename(columns={
    'Participation': 'Participation_x',
    'Math': 'Math_x'
})

# Rename columns in df1 to match target schema partially:
# Participation -> Participation_y
# Math -> Math_y
df1_renamed = df1.rename(columns={
    'Participation': 'Participation_y',
    'Math': 'Math_y'
})

# Merge the two dataframes on 'State'
# This will combine all columns from both sources
df_merged = pd.merge(df0_renamed, df1_renamed, on='State', how='inner')

# Select and reorder columns to match target schema:
# ['State', 'Participation_x', 'English', 'Math_x', 'Reading', 'Science', 'Composite',
#  'Participation_y', 'Evidence-Based Reading and Writing', 'Math_y', 'Total']

target_columns = [
    'State',
    'Participation_x',
    'English',
    'Math_x',
    'Reading',
    'Science',
    'Composite',
    'Participation_y',
    'Evidence-Based Reading and Writing',
    'Math_y',
    'Total'
]

df_target = df_merged[target_columns]

# Convert data types according to target schema:
# 'State': string (already string)
# 'Participation_x': string (already string)
# 'English': float
# 'Math_x': float
# 'Reading': float
# 'Science': float
# 'Composite': float
# 'Participation_y': string
# 'Evidence-Based Reading and Writing': integer
# 'Math_y': integer
# 'Total': integer

# Convert numeric columns
float_cols = ['English', 'Math_x', 'Reading', 'Science', 'Composite']
int_cols = ['Evidence-Based Reading and Writing', 'Math_y', 'Total']

# Convert floats
for col in float_cols:
    df_target[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_target[col], errors='coerce')

# Convert ints
for col in int_cols:
    df_target[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_target[col], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')  # Nullable integer dtype

# Ensure string columns are string type
df_target['State'] = df_target['State'].astype(str)
df_target['Participation_x'] = df_target['Participation_x'].astype(str)
df_target['Participation_y'] = df_target['Participation_y'].astype(str)

# Write the result to the target CSV file
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_45/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
